templates.subject: CRITICAL: Deficiency Notice Issued for AICTE Application {{applicationNumber}}
templates.inAppTitle: Deficiencies Flagged - Action Required Within 7 Days
templates.inAppBodyTemplate: Scrutiny Officer has flagged {{deficiencyCount}} itemized deficiencies for {{institutionName}} ({{applicationNumber}}). Cure deadline is {{deficiencyDueDate}}.
templates.emailSubjectTemplate: AICTE Deficiency Notice: {{applicationNumber}} - Rectification Required by {{deficiencyDueDate}}
templates.emailHtmlTemplate:
Dear Applicant,

Deficiencies have been identified in your application {{applicationNumber}}.

Summary of Deficiencies: {{deficienciesSummary}}

You must upload rectified certified documents by {{deficiencyDueDate}} (23:59:59 UTC).

Failure to respond within 7 calendar days will result in matter referral to Standing Hearing Committee.
